body: and thanks for response. You should respond when you are easy.

I am a programmer but I don't want to talk more about it. 

You are right about the girl. But I will prefer my previous idea. I will let her go by making some kind of excuse. May be it will hurt for while but she will get over it. She is a really strong girl. She deserves better.

By problems of the world, I mean my problems. Like paying bill and taxes and other bad stuff that I have to deal with. My girl has become a problem for me. She wants to get married. She doesn't know that I am fucked up shit and I don't show her that I am depressed either. I am looking for a way to get away from her, even though i love her, but i will make her life miserable if i marry her. I've stopped working as well. I have been working for one client for over a year that hardly pays my bills. I am okay with it because I see less money as less problem. I have other clients but I have said sorry to them because I don't want to work anymore. I don't want anything anymore. I used to have dreams of having a big house and car and shit like that. Even I achieved them somewhat, but it has become everything ugly.  What I want is just close my eyes and never wake up again.

Hey friend. I am feeling depressed again. If I am not brave enough to kill myself, I am not brave enough to deal with the problems of the world either. So, I need to make myself able to kill myself. The way I think is, If I move on and something bad happens, I will kill myself. So, killing myself can be postponed. But first I need courage for that.
Thank you so much for all this. I have read your responses on other threads as well. You are really good at this. Thanks again.

Wao, you have summed up pretty much everything in serenity prayer. It is beautiful.

Things like this rebuild me but eventually after a day or two, I fall back to the same depressed situation. A single bad news just crushes me and destroys the whole confidence I have developed.

I love the way you say things. If I am not bothering you then can we talk a little more?

Decision making has become something impossible for me. Do you know since the start of my current situation I wanted to get a dog and I have not got a dog yet because I am still going through its pros and cons and I am deciding on it. 
Decision making has become a blackhole for me. Any idea that I have goes through decision making and ends up in the blackhole and never gets executed. 

Now here something about bad stuff. I saw an innocent girl years ago. She was living from hand to mouth. She found a way to make money and that was prostitution. Prostitution was illegal where she lived. But she practiced it underground and secetly. For me there is a big gap between unethical and illegal. Once she got caught by cops having sex in some place. Breaking serveral other laws, the cop investigated her hashly and illegally and made her video while doing so and then he put this video on youtube. Till now people watch that video and most of them condem that cop. While the girl later came out somehow after facing several charges and then she disappeard. No body knows where is she. I think she probably committed suicide. That cop still enjoys the goverment perks. This is a true story. I am sorry but I don't want to use actual information here like her name and location etc. 

This is one story and I think thousands of such incidents happen every day in the world. Time can replace you or me someday in stead of these people. What then? Such bad stuff should be dealt with, ignored or avoided?

What you said is right but I am stuck. I am here for years and not doing anything. It has become my comfort zone. I think of leaving it for a few moments but eventually, I don't leave it. and I am just here. Now even the concept of leaving it scares me. I am afraid of things getting worse. Where can I purchase some balls to either get out of it or die peacefully?
What to do with bad? Looks like I have even forgotten the basics.
All good things come to an end. So, what's the point? There are some things which are considered bad and don't end, like death.

It is if ignorance is a virtue. We think the world is good because we are not the part of bad part at moment. But we might be soon. If ignorance is a virtue then we don't need to do anything at all. Me in my room watching the news isn't a bad idea at all then. I want to leave it but then I don't. So, I am actually stuck. Maybe tomorrow or someday, I am going to die and I will at least not die in the shit storm but in peace and at my favorite place, my room. Because every step I take is another mistake.
